newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil exports $1.123 billion October's 4th week.
newsitem.headline: Brazil exports $1.123 billion October's 4th week.

text.p: Brazilian exports in the fourth week of October totalled $1.123 billion, up from $1.065 billion in the same week last month, the Industry and Commerce Ministry said.

The daily average value of goods exported during October's fourth week, which had five working days, was $224.16 million, up from $213 million in the fourth week of September, which also had five days, a ministry spokeswoman said.
Exports in October so far have grossed $3.570 billion. In September as a whole, exports totalled $4.115 billion, she said
